This physically demanding job requires lifting packages weighing between 5 and 20 kilos, which you will sort and stack on pallets or in cages. Your workday begins with scanning packages, placing them on the conveyor belt, and removing them from the chutes at the end. You will then stack them neatly, ensuring everything is done safely and efficiently. Working alongside your colleagues, you'll maintain a steady pace, enjoying the variety each day brings while using modern tools. If you enjoy staying active and prefer working in the evening or at night, this job is perfect for you. You'll earn a competitive salary with bonuses, in an open atmosphere with clear instructions.
